messages:
noah_eng: quick follow-up from the all-hands infra segment — thanks for the clarity earlier! :wave:
noah_eng: two quick items: 1) which GPU SKUs are earmarked for Dedicated vs Hosted? 2) how will autoscale warm pools impact tail latency for sudden spikes?

leah_infra: short version: Dedicated gets H100/A100 primarily. Hosted mixes those for high tiers and cheaper cards (T4/RTX-class) for low-cost embedding hosts and autoscale fallbacks. Shipments are phased; expect inventory waves over the next 4-8 weeks.

dmitri_sre: warm pools set per-region and sized by cluster; default min_warm_instances = 2 for small clusters, higher for large. Warm pools cover common spikes so p95/p99 should be stable. For >10x bursts we rely on preemptible cloud capacity or fallback to quantized/smaller model variants to avoid huge latency hits.

sophia_product: can we show "estimated availability" on the reservation UI and a short note in signup flows so we don't overpromise for APAC?

leah_infra: yes — console will show ETA and inventory status. Signup UX will include a short line: "Region availability subject to phased hardware shipments."

infra-bot: [deploy] autoscaler-v2 canary scheduled 2026-07-02T01:30Z -> 10% Dedicated clusters. Monitor: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

dmitri_sre: config snippet teams can use to emulate: ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  burst_capacity_percent: 20
  cold_start_timeout_ms: 120
```

noah_eng: any billing changes tied to burst usage?

leah_infra: committed pricing unchanged. Burst (preemptible) usage billed separately at burst rates; console will surface cost estimates from historical traffic.

maya_ceo: request: infra to publish a one-pager + short FAQ by Friday so support & growth have consistent language.

leah_infra: will deliver FAQ and one-pager by Friday EOD.

noah_eng: great, please post here when it's up so I can link to it in the product notes. :thumbsup:
